status: REVIEWED SOURCE INPUT (MC04-S7 Revision 5 item 2): minimal reflow pins
rule: Before stage 7 the floorplan re-placed every package that design/partition/adopted-placement-pins.json does not pin (added passives and diodes) on each regeneration, so any change in occupancy re-flowed them. This writes design/partition/reflow-pins.json: each such package on JL, JR and K at its pose in the floorplan of the source commit below, so only packages a moved block, a new GH header or an eviction displaces move. A swapped IC and its bypass capacitors are recorded as one swapped cluster at their pre-move poses, which the floorplan takes before searching from the swapped slot, and a pin the floorplan evicted keeps its pre-move re-placed pose when that pose is free. A protection diode (placed by its locality rule) records its pre-move pose, which the floorplan tries first. Fixed panel parts, headers (from the connector packing) and the K block members are left out. --check fails on drift.
